text: Tax refund. You forgot you were owed this.
Parking tickets you ignored caught up.
Your old couch sold for more than it deserved.
You returned a wallet. They wrote you a note.
The used car needs a new transmission. Already.
A friend covers dinner. You were going to.
You forget to split the bill evenly.
You ghost a group project and it shows.
Lab fees nobody put in the brochure.
You find a scholarship you actually qualify for.
The campus meal plan does not include dignity.
Overtime hits the account. You feel it in your back.
Tips were good. The night was long.
You needed new boots for the job. Already.
Conference you had to attend. Out of pocket.
A grant comes through. Small, but it comes through.
Your name is on the paper. You actually wrote it.
Side gig actually pays this month.
Work trip you fronted. Reimbursement pending.
Credit-card points you actually redeem.
Physical therapy copay. You knew it was coming.
You sold the old bike for more than it was worth.
HOA special assessment. Nobody is happy.
A relative leaves you a little something.
You skip the thing. They notice.
You didn't go out. The money is still there.
Impulse gadget. In a drawer by Friday.
You give a stranger a jump in the rain.
You cover a friend's shortfall quietly.
The kid's lemonade stand, minus the sugar.
Dental work nobody budgeted for.
Bonus year. Don't get used to it.
You write the recommendation that gets them the job.
Another book. You already had two copies.
Family emergency travel. Last-minute fares.
Insurance actually covers it. Shocking.
Field trip money. Again.
A hobby turns into a little extra income.
You finally replace the thing you've been patching.
Downsizing sale. The attic was a gold mine.
